stack: Python3.12 standard library HTTP+SQLite business backend with a PySide6-Essentials 6.12.0 QtWidgets native desktop GUI. Normal startup opens native widgets, with no default browser launch and no WebView/QtWebEngine dependency. Windows distributions bundle the desktop runtime. The localhost HTTP/CLI/MCP contract remains available internally; closing the GUI leaves the service running for tools. desktop --service-only and compatible --no-browser start only the local API. Legacy static HTML/CSS/JavaScript remains an internal compatibility surface. Repository root contains source, docs, tests and build scripts. Internal leadworkbench modules, executable names, data paths and HTTP field shapes remain compatible.

api.response: {ok:true,data:any}; errors {ok:false,error:{code,message,details?}}; JSON body max4MB; API same-origin protected mutation with X-App-Token from /api/bootstrap. bind127.0.0.1 only.
routes: GET /api/bootstrap -> {app_version,app_name,token,settings,capabilities}; capabilities.platforms supplies actual read/search capability and experimental flags; capabilities.max_batch_candidates=50 is the released shared total cap, separate from per-platform read limits.
GET /api/runs?scope=active|trash|all -> {items:[Run]}; default active excludes trash; trash/all returns public task metadata, not checkpoint records.

POST /api/runs body {name,source:'demo'|'import'|'urls'|'opencli'|'comments',goal,queries:[],platforms:[],urls:[],records:[],limit:20,targeting?:Targeting,analysis_mode?:'collect_only'|'local',collection?:Collection} -> Run (created, not automatically started)

POST /api/runs/trash|restore|purge body {run_ids:[1..100 distinct IDs],operation_id} -> RunLifecycleReceipt. Atomic batch. Running/pause_requested/still-scheduled tasks reject with RUN_RUNNING/RUN_BUSY; purge requires trash. Trash operations and engine control share lifecycle locking.

GET /api/candidates?run_id=&q=&decision=&ai_decision=&order=&limit=100&offset=0 -> {items:[CandidateSummary],total}; ai_decision=keep|needs_info|watch|exclude|unanalysed, order=collected|ai_priority. AI filters are independent of final review filters; stable sort before pagination.

POST /api/reviews body {run_id,reviewer:'human'|'codex'|'dsh',operation_id,changes:[{candidate_id,base_version,decision:'keep'|'exclude'|'needs_info'|'watch',reason,evidence_ids:[],tags:[]}]} -> Changeset; atomic optimistic versions, idempotency; source evidence unchanged
POST /api/reviews/{id}/revert body {operation_id} -> reverted Changeset; conflict if any candidate changed since review
GET /api/runs/{id}/export?format=json|csv -> file export (JSON includes immutable snapshot and proposed review schema)
PUT /api/settings body model/OpenCLI config -> masked settings
POST /api/import/validate body {records:[]} -> normalized records and warnings
POST /api/search/preview body {targeting,queries:[],platforms:[]} -> {targeting,queries,summary,platforms,manual_links,warnings}; deterministic no platform or model call

Run.name: str

config.targeting: Targeting; missing in old runs means global/business
config.analysis_mode: collect_only|local; saved at creation from explicit value or model.enabled default; old runs lacking mode honor current default
config.collection: Collection; source comments forces scope comments; urls accepts posts only

progress.collection_summary: Optional comment receipt with posts_supplied/attempted/succeeded, comments_read/matched/returned, post_results and partial/error details. Bounded sample, never global index.

batch_summary.requested_limit: saved config.limit; original pre-clamp payload cannot be recovered for old runs
batch_summary.effective_limit: min(saved request,current preference,50); current effective cap, not promise of actual results
batch_summary.collected: checkpoint.records length, or stored candidate count for legacy runs
batch_summary.ai_analyzed: completed inference results; synthetic-demo processing and missing provenance excluded
batch_summary.unanalysed: saved candidates without completed inference provenance
batch_summary.collection_complete: boolean from checkpoint, or null for legacy records

Run.deleted_at: optional ISO timestamp; present only in recycle bin. Original execution status, evidence, checkpoints and reviews remain until explicit purge.

CandidateSummary.comment_id: native ID|null; fingerprint dedup if missing
CandidateSummary.ai_decision: keep|needs_info|watch|exclude|null; read-only completed AI suggestion, independent of effective_decision. Never a human review.

types.CandidateDetail: Summary + {evidence:[{id,kind:'post'|'website'|'comment'|'import',source_url,content,quote,posted_at,retrieved_at,content_sha256,is_demo}],analysis:{role,priority,decision,reason,facts:{},unknown_fields:[],citations:[],model,protocol,prompt_version,analysis_status},reviews:[]}; targeted analyses also contain {targeting,target_match:{status,reason,matched_tags,missing_fields,matched_region,region_evidence,custom_evidence},input_window:{original_chars,analyzed_chars,truncated},validation_retries?}; targeted facts also support budget,property_type,area,renovation_stage,start_date; each requires a verbatim value+source quote, budget/area cannot be quantity. collect_only analysis has not_requested, decision/model/protocol/prompt_version=null and no inferred facts; evidence metadata preserves commenter identity and parent context separately.

Collection.keywords: array of up to20 strings; empty means all read comments
Collection.match_mode: any|all; literal case-insensitive substring match within comment text
Collection.max_comments_per_post: 1..100; default20; native adapter caps may be lower
Collection.include_replies: boolean defaultfalse; bounded native replies where supported

RunLifecycleReceipt.changed_count: number of affected tasks; entire batch or none

python_interfaces.leadworkbench/engine.py: class RunEngine(store). start(run_id)->None; pause(run_id)->None; resume(run_id)->None; shutdown()->None. Worker thread(s) serial model requests default1. Uses Store helpers below. manage_runs shares Store.lifecycle_lock and the actual scheduled-run set; no lifecycle mutation while a worker or final log owns a task.
python_interfaces.leadworkbench/models.py: test_connection(settings)->dict; plan_queries(settings,goal,queries,platforms)->list[str]; analyze_evidence(settings,record)->dict (strict JSON, evidence citation validation; unknown facts never promoted). Standard library urllib no proxy for localhost.
python_interfaces.leadworkbench/collectors.py: normalize_records(records)->(records,warnings); collect_urls(urls,limit)-> records generator; collect_opencli(queries,platforms,limit,config)-> records generator. Canonical record {source_url,platform,brand_name?,author_handle?,content,posted_at?,company_website?,country?,is_partial?,metadata?}. No writes/DMs/cookies. platform_catalog()->9 platform capabilities; domestic6 installed adapters + fixed read-only experimentalKuaishouDOM; retainpartial and own-tabcleanup; collect_comments(post_urls,platforms,limit,config,options) -> generator returning collection_summary; record_identity(record) preserves independent comments under one parent URL
python_interfaces.leadworkbench/demo.py: synthetic_records()->list records; synthetic_analysis(record)->dict; all .invalid URLs, is_demo=True; visibly labeled, no fake real leads.
python_interfaces.leadworkbench/store.py: Store(data_dir). get_settings(include_secret=False), update_settings(patch), get_run(id), update_run(id,**fields), log_event(run_id,level,message,details=None), list_candidates(run_id,...), add_candidate(run_id,record,analysis)->dict, freeze_run(run_id), export_run(run_id)->dict. add_candidate validates immutable content evidence, dedup record_identity in run (comment IDs/fingerprints plus parent, not parent URL alone), no clearing old human review on resume. get_run adds read-only batch_summary; list_candidates(run_id,q,decision,limit,offset,ai_decision="",order="") supports independent AI filters and stable priority order. list_runs(scope="active"); get_run(id,include_deleted=False); manage_runs(action,run_ids,operation_id) atomic lifecycle. Default data reads and review retries reject deleted tasks before returning cached business results.
python_interfaces.leadworkbench/cli.py: HTTP client via server.json in --data-dir, commands serve/runs/show/candidates/evidence/review-export/review-apply/review-revert/demo/model-test/mcp. JSON stdout errors stderr, no direct SQLite writes.
python_interfaces.leadworkbench/mcp.py: stdlib JSON-RPC MCP stdio exposing runs_list,candidates_list,evidence_get,reviews_submit,reviews_revert,runs_start/runs_pause. HTTP app client only, notifications correct, protocol latest accepted 2025-03-26/2024-11-05; no initialize fake capabilities.
python_interfaces.leadworkbench/targeting.py: normalize_targeting, active_targeting, build_queries, search_preview; source-based region guard, bounded conditions and explicit query coverage warnings
python_interfaces.leadworkbench/comments.py: Read-only bounded adapters for weibo comments(+post ID resolution), xiaohongshu comments (signed note URL), bilibili comments (video BV), zhihu answer-comments (answer URL); no singular write comment commands; keyword filtering after bounded read.
python_interfaces.leadworkbench/processing.py: normalize_analysis_mode; normalize_collection; collected_analysis: raw evidence only, no model calls or local judgment.
python_interfaces.leadworkbench/native_tasks.py: TaskManagerDialog(client,parent=None,initial_tab="active") with task/trash tabs, search/status filters, multi-selection, asynchronous lifecycle mutations and changed(object) receipt. No direct storage access.

model.enabled_semantics: new-run default only; app connects to user-started service, never starts/stops controller; no cloud fallback

platforms.runtime_requires: OpenCLI Browser Bridge connection and relevant platform login. Code/fixture support is not live collection proof.
platforms.comment_limits: Selected/discovered parent samples; Zhihu answers only, Bilibili videos only; Xiaohongshu needs full xsec_token URL; no global comment index. Other platforms search posts but comments unsupported.

collection_lifecycle.mode: one finite batch, not continuous monitoring
stop_collecting_when: source error or requested pause handled at step boundary
collection_lifecycle.after_collection: optional serial local inference, then completed/partial/failed state
collection_lifecycle.pause: waits for in-flight network/model step before checkpoint pause
